subject.title: Periodic usage-limit failures (weekly/monthly) are silently swallowed in group chats — user-copy path ignores typed FailoverError.reason

question: Which linked fix PR should own the protected maintainer-labeled repair for this issue?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and narrow, but the issue has a protected `maintainer` label and two open closing PRs, so automation should not choose or land the canonical branch without maintainer intent.

options.title: Use the fuller fix PR
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102643 as the canonical fix because it includes the typed-reason repair plus focused group/channel coverage and related copy adjustments.

options.title: Use the minimal fix PR
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102657 instead if maintainers want only the two-line typed-reason classifier change and are willing to handle its proof/context gaps.

options.title: Hold for broader failover-notice work
options.body: Keep both linked PRs paused if maintainers want this behavior folded into the broader failover-notice direction tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92672.

recommendation.title: Use the fuller fix PR
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102643 as the canonical fix because it includes the typed-reason repair plus focused group/channel coverage and related copy adjustments.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent delivery-policy work on the same group/channel silent-failure boundary makes this the best available routing owner from history.
